parole.significato: A lesson on a topic in the Qurʾān or Sunna.
parole.testo: From Arabic دَرْس (dars), often via Urdu.

parole.significato: A person who accompanied Muhammad during his migration from Mecca to Medina in 622.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Arabic مُهَاجِر (muhājir, literally “emigrant”). Sense 2 is from its Urdu derivative مُہَاجِر (muhājir).

parole.significato: An honorific title borne by female descendants of the prophet Muhammad.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Arabic سَيِّدَة (sayyida). * (female given name): From Urdu سیدہ, from Arabic سَيِّدَة (sayyida)
